seo.title: Automated Presence and Feedback (APFS): Case Study
seo.description: How Spectrum built APFS, used by ministries and government offices: app-based attendance with location and photo check-in, leave, feedback and office ratings, on Android and iOS.

hero.title: Automated *Presence & Feedback*
hero.lead: How Spectrum built APFS, the attendance and feedback system now used by ministries and government offices, from the Ministry of Land to the Noakhali DC Office.

sections.title: At a glance
body: Government offices need to know who is at work, and citizens want to be heard about the service they get. Spectrum built APFS, Automated Presence and Feedback, which handles both: staff check in from their phone at the office, and people rate and comment on offices. It is now used by ministries and government offices across Bangladesh.

sections.title: The problem
body: Attendance in many offices was kept in paper registers or on machines at the door, leave requests went around on paper, and managers had no live view of who was in.
Feedback about offices and their services was hard to collect and even harder to act on.

sections.title: What we built
sections.intro: One system for attendance, leave and feedback, on Android and iOS:

items.title: Check-in and check-out from the phone,
items.text: confirmed by the office location and a photo. The app warns staff when they are outside the office area.

items.title: Leave management:
items.text: apply for leave, see leave balances and follow each request.

items.title: Feedback and reporting:
items.text: share suggestions, report office problems, and follow what happens to them.

items.title: Office ratings:
items.text: offices are listed with star ratings from feedback.

items.title: Helplines and services:
items.text: support directories, emergency numbers and internal service requests.

items.title: Staff directory and office map,
items.text: showing colleagues by department and the approved check-in zones.

items.title: Live data for managers
items.text: on attendance and participation, as it happens.

items.title: Arrive and check in
items.text: At the office, staff check in on the app. The location and a photo confirm it.

items.title: Work and request leave
items.text: Leave requests and balances are handled in the same app.

items.title: Give feedback
items.text: Staff and visitors share feedback and rate the office.

items.title: Managers see it live
items.text: Attendance and feedback appear as they happen, ready for reports.

sections.title: Results
bullets: Used by six government bodies, including the Ministry of Land and the Ministry of Agriculture.
Attendance is recorded with location and photo, so it cannot simply be marked for someone else.
Leave and feedback no longer depend on paper.
Managers see attendance and feedback as they happen.

items.title: Location check:

items.title: Photo confirmation:
items.text: a photo is taken with each check-in.
